team.aboutUs: We are Kobalto Games, a small indie studio located in Spain, formed by a group of friends who create quirky worlds one pixel at a time. Whether we're organizing chaos or watching tiny kobolds make big messes, we're all about creating unique and charming worlds.

gamesInfo.suppersDesc: Suppers & Daggers is a tactical RPG where chaos meets strategy. Lead your daggers on missions full of surprises and turn-based combat.
gamesInfo.suppersWah: Wah!Topia is an adventure RPG in a pixelated world full of mysteries. Explore unknown lands, solve puzzles, and discover the truth behind the kingdom.

suppers.name: Suppers & Daggers
suppers.desc: Suppers & Daggers is a world where cards and daggers face off in tactical battles. Explore missions, rally allies, and conquer the chaos.

wahTopia.name: Wah!Topia
wahTopia.desc: Wah!Topia is a kingdom in crisis. Travel through pixelated landscapes, discover ancient secrets, and save the world from darkness.
